android.releaseNotes:
NexPlay 2.0.4

About: developer credit is now ms-nicky, and the repository link has been removed.

Carried over from 2.0.3, rebased onto OpenNOW android-native 2.0.3:

New: HDR output, stream recording, gyroscope input, touch controller skins and presets, 12 locales, settings backup, bug report threads.

Security: APK updates require the manifest to publish a sha256 and are re-verified at install time; release builds trust only system certificate roots; the live broadcast stream key is no longer written to logs.

Tests: 1169 unit tests.
